cards.title: Why it works
items: Blindness is structural: each scoring seat consumes only artifact paths, never the author's defense or the repair's claim of resolution
Bounded admission: the single repair pass is gated and never re-entered, and the second-disagreement STOP is a machine `when` on a count, not prose
Dispositions are echoes - every arm commits its verdict at no token cost

items: {{nodes}} nodes, {{agents}} seats, {{gates}} machine gates, {{echoes}} dispositions: author -> blind rubric -> gated repair pass -> frontier re-score -> halt/admit pair
